meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂工作拆成多个环节,派给多个助手并行执行并汇总结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务太重,想拆给多个 AI 助手分头做完再统一汇总。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a task is too big to do alone and you want several assistants to split it and report back.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会协调受监督的 Orca worker:线程化消息、阻塞式 ask/reply、任务派发、等待 worker_done 或升级、任务 DAG、决策门与协调循环,并把工作拆分给多个 agent。
howto.when: 当你要求监督、监控、等待结果或协调一个 DAG 时触发;若只是把任务整体交接给另一个 agent,原文指定改用 orca-cli 技能。

say.text: 用 Orca 起一个协调循环,把这项任务派发给两个 worker
say.note: 会先加载与二进制版本匹配的指南

say.text: 阻塞等待那个 worker 的 ask/reply,拿到结果再继续
把这项工作拆成任务 DAG,派发并在完成后汇报

howto.what_en: After install, Claude coordinates supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, waits for worker_done or escalation, task DAGs, decision gates and coordinator loops, splitting work across agents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to supervise, monitor, wait for results, or coordinate a DAG; for a full ownership handoff to another agent, the doc points to the orca-cli skill instead.

say_en.text: Start an Orca coordinator loop and dispatch this task to two workers
Block on that worker's ask/reply and continue once it answers
Split this work into a task DAG, dispatch it, and report when done
say_en.note: Includes decision gates and done waits
